title: Calculate the average number of triple bonds per carcinogenic molecule that
question: Calculate the average number of triple bonds per carcinogenic molecule that contains nitrogen atoms, excluding any molecules where nitrogen atoms cannot form connections.

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(triple_bond_count) AS average_triple_bonds
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id,
        COUNT(b.XCL_004) AS triple_bond_count
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
      AND a.XCL_003 = 'n'
      AND b.XCL_006 = '#'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 
          FROM atom a2 
          LEFT JOIN connected c2 ON a2.XCL_001 = c2.XCL_007
          WHERE a2.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
            AND a2.XCL_003 = 'n'
            AND c2.XCL_007 IS NULL
      )
    GROUP BY m.XCL_010
) AS subquery

    GROUP BY m.XCL_010
) AS subquery
